name: C11_H8_SURVIVOR_FAMILY_GATE_V1

source_binding.paper: Four-Coloring P6-Free Graphs. II. Finding an Excellent Precoloring
interface: acceptability considers nonadjacent y,y' in descendant Y' intersect N(Y0') with unequal lists and an extension coloring both from their list intersection
the published contradiction uses the terminal configuration z-y-s-p-m-n
the H8 theorem strengthens every authoritative C11 survivor to the same canonical graph/list kernel

fixed_context.orientation: choose the frozen C11 symmetry orientation with f'(m) in L(y)

graph_discoverable_sets.A: { y in Y'(T) intersect N(Y0') : ym is a nonedge }
graph_discoverable_sets.B: { y' in Y'(T') intersect N(Y0') : y'm is an edge }
graph_discoverable_sets.note: A and B are constructed from graph/state data only; no extension oracle is allowed.

structural_candidate_family.definition: K_graph consists of all ordered triples (y,y',z) with y in A, y' in B, z in Y0' intersect N(y) intersect N(y'), and yy' a nonedge.
structural_candidate_family.h8_binding: Every answer-relevant C11 survivor is a member of K_graph and induces the frozen canonical H8 for every s in T,t in T'.

answer_relevant_survivor.definition: A triple (y,y',z) in K_graph is answer-relevant iff there exists an extension c of P' with c(y),c(y') in {3,4}.
answer_relevant_survivor.forbidden_use: The construction/enumeration/representative algorithm may not query whether such c exists.

frozen_color_dimension.interpretation: Color degrees of freedom are constant; the gate concerns multiplicity and interaction, not local color-state explosion.

target_question: For a fixed ordered type pair, fixed stored 111 state and fixed descendant P', can the full graph-discoverable H8 survivor family be represented in a way compatible with the bounded-seed / n^{q(|S|)} proof architecture, without consulting an extension witness?

F1_UNIQUE_OR_BOUNDED_KERNEL_FAMILY.label: F1_UNIQUE_BOUNDED_KERNEL_FAMILY
pass_requires: There exists a graph/state-only procedure producing a canonical family K* containing every answer-relevant survivor.
|K*| <= g(|S|) for some function g independent of n.
The bound and construction are proved from frozen hypotheses only.
F1_UNIQUE_OR_BOUNDED_KERNEL_FAMILY.implication_ceiling: Bounded explicit absorption becomes a plausible future repair interface; no repair is authorized.

F2_BOUNDED_HITTING_REPRESENTATIVES.label: F2_BOUNDED_HITTING_REPRESENTATIVES
pass_requires: The survivor family may be unbounded.
There exists a graph/state-only representative/hitting set R with |R| <= g(|S|).
The hit relation is explicitly defined on vertices, oriented survivor pairs, or canonical H8 kernels.
Every answer-relevant survivor is hit/represented by R under that exact relation.
The proof must explain why the relation preserves all information needed to distinguish answer-relevant survivors at this gate; mere set intersection is insufficient.
F2_BOUNDED_HITTING_REPRESENTATIVES.implication_ceiling: Bounded representative repair becomes plausible; no repair is authorized.

F3_POLYNOMIAL_EXACT_QUOTIENT.label: F3_POLYNOMIAL_EXACT_QUOTIENT
pass_requires: A graph/state-only equivalence relation on structural candidates is explicitly defined and polynomially decidable.
The number of classes is <= n^{h(|S|)}.
Each class has a polynomial-size summary whose size does not scale with the number of H8 members in that class.
The summary preserves exactly the class extension projection relevant to the frozen boundary/state, including the {3,4} color interface.
Class summaries and the quotient are polynomially discoverable without an extension oracle.
The result is nontrivial: counting raw triples (<=n^3) without an exact class-level semantic summary does NOT satisfy F3.
F3_POLYNOMIAL_EXACT_QUOTIENT.implication_ceiling: A quotient-style future repair becomes plausible; no repair is authorized.

F4_UNRESOLVED_MULTIPLICITY.label: F4_UNRESOLVED_MULTIPLICITY
F4_UNRESOLVED_MULTIPLICITY.condition: None of F1, F2, or F3 is proved under the frozen authority.
F4_UNRESOLVED_MULTIPLICITY.implication_ceiling: STOP. No hardness, lower bound, or impossibility conclusion.

outcome_precedence: If F1 is proved, record F1 and also whether F2/F3 follow as corollaries, but F1 is the primary outcome.
Else if F2 is proved, record F2.
Else if F3 is proved, record F3.
multiplicity_objects_to_measure: number of distinct ordered pairs (y,y') admitting at least one common z
multiplicity of common-z witnesses per ordered pair
adjacency/twin/profile structure of A and B relative to the frozen boundary and Y0'
interaction among multiple H8 kernels sharing y, y', z, p, m, or n
whether P7-freeness forces bounded neighborhoods, modules, twin classes, complete/anticomplete patterns, or bounded hitting structure

authority_firewalls.extension_c: May witness completeness or refute a proposed representation, but may not be queried by the construction.
authority_firewalls.source_001: Retained quarantined; any dependency on disputed 001 semantics has affects_main_authority=false.
authority_firewalls.upstream_H8: May be used as theorem authority; must not be modified.
authority_firewalls.no_hidden_absorption: Adding any y/y' to seed during this gate is forbidden.
authority_firewalls.no_new_descriptor: No new state field or quotient object is promoted into Lemma 11 during this gate.

future_repair_candidate_quarantined.name: C11_ABSORB(y,y')
local_idea: add a chosen y,y' to enlarged seed
keep z auxiliary rather than support
future_repair_candidate_quarantined.known_gap: Destroying one H8 does not imply elimination of all C11 survivors for the same stored state/type pair.

prohibited_shortcuts: F1 may not count only answer-relevant survivors using an extension oracle.
F2 may not call an arbitrary intersecting set a representative set without an exact coverage/semantic statement.
F3 may not pass merely because all triples are polynomially enumerable.
Constant 16/8 color signatures do not imply bounded survivor multiplicity.
A large or unbounded family does not imply hardness.
forbidden: define or promote a new descriptor
next_action: Structural multiplicity/representability audit only after explicit authorization; no repair is auto-authorized.
